name: Kasrawad — Itbardi stupa mound
notes: Excavated 1936-39 under V.N. Singh, Indore Museum (Holkar State). Itbardi = brick mound. 11 stupas reported in MP summaries. ASI site of national importance. Coordinates are the published town/site coordinates (22°08′N 75°37′E) — mound may sit within ~1 km of this point.

name: Bagh Caves
notes: 9 rock-cut Buddhist caves (5 survive), 5th–6th c. CE, sandstone cliff above Baghni river. NOT a mound — DEM bump detector is not expected to find it; it is a slope/cliff site and serves as a negative control for the mound detector.

name: Maheshwar / Navdatoli
notes: Opposite banks of the Narmada at 22°11′N 75°36′E. Chalcolithic Navdatoli (2nd mill. BCE) + historic Mahishmati. Positive control for a river-bank settlement mound landscape.

name: Mandleshwar
notes: 22°11′N 75°40′E, north bank of Narmada, medieval fort near river bed, earlier deposits reported in district surveys.

name: Anjad
notes: Barwani district town in the Narmada valley, included because the user named 'Anjar Bhawani' — closest matching place. No published Buddhist site here; serves as a search cell, not a known site.
